ch.h:
Why isn’t the giant listening, OPEN THE DOOR, LET ME OUT. The night that encroached upon, left him rendered helpless. The fake suns within the building were of no use. He needed light, he needed his freedom, but in this land of Giants, Drone was left trapped.

As his last approach, he zipped and flew around them to gain their attention. He circled and screamed by their ears to let him out, to help him, but the giants simply ignored. Slowly losing the buzz and tiring out, drone slowed down, that’s when … SLAP,

Justin got the fly, back to TV in peace now.
